mapper.select: SELECT X.ID AS id , 'CUST-' || LPAD(MOD(X.ID, 1000), 5, '0') AS customer_code , 'Sample Product ' || MOD(X.ID, 50) AS product_name , CASE WHEN MOD(X.ID, 11) = 0 THEN 'CANCELED' WHEN MOD(X.ID, 3) = 0 THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'COMPLETED' END AS status , MOD(X.ID, 1000) * 1000 + 500 AS amount , DATEADD('DAY', MOD(X.ID, 365), DATE '2026-01-01') AS requested_date FROM SYSTEM_RANGE(1, #{totalRows}) AS X(ID) ORDER BY X.ID OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT X.ID AS id , 'CUST-' || LPAD(MOD(X.ID, 1000), 5, '0') AS customer_code , 'Sample Product ' || MOD(X.ID, 50) AS product_name , CASE WHEN MOD(X.ID, 11) = 0 THEN 'CANCELED' WHEN MOD(X.ID, 3) = 0 THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'COMPLETED' END AS status , MOD(X.ID, 1000) * 1000 + 500 AS amount , DATEADD('DAY', MOD(X.ID, 365), DATE '2026-01-01') AS requested_date FROM SYSTEM_RANGE(1, #{totalRows}) AS X(ID) ORDER BY X.ID
